adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/email-manager.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails` builds `emailsToSend` by always emailing the organizer, every `calendarEvent.team.members`, and then mapping over *all* `calendarEvent.attendees` to send an email per attendee (either `AttendeeScheduledEmail` for `newGuests` or `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail` for existing attendees), and then sends them via a single `await Promise.all(emailsToSend)`. So the number of emails sent per mutation scales with total attendee count (plus team members), not just the number of newly added guests. This is a diff-grounded scalability/throughput concern, though it may be intentional behavior rather than a correctness defect.
